facts.text: Jon mentions that seeing his students succeed motivates him in his dance studio business.

evidence.quote: Seeing my students succeed motivates me. It's awesome to help them learn and reach their goals.

facts.text: Gina acknowledges that Jon's support means a lot to her and expresses appreciation for being part of his journey.

evidence.quote: That's awesome, Jon! Seeing your students grow and succeed must be really fulfilling. Glad I can be part of this journey!

facts.text: Jon shares a photo of a group of women doing a dance routine, which he describes as being after one of his dance classes.

evidence.quote: Here's a photo of us after during one of the dance clases. [image: a photography of a group of women doing a dance routine]

facts.text: Gina expresses that she is enjoying running her store and has been keeping up with fashion trends to offer the best pieces to her customers.

evidence.quote: Store's going good, just been keeping up with fashion trends so I can offer the best pieces to customers.
